versions.changelog:
No functional or documentation changes detected for version 1.0.2.

- No file modifications present compared to the previous version.
- SKILL.md and all relevant documentation remain unchanged.
- No new features, bug fixes, or behavioral adjustments included in this release.

Version 1.0.1

- Switched from custom mcporter-based workflow to standard Tencent Cloud CLI (tccli).
- Added detailed OAuth-based and AK/SK-based credential setup instructions with helper script.
- Modularized usage guides into scenario-specific reference files (instance, firewall, snapshot, monitoring, application deployment, traffic, remote commands).
- Improved safety, output compatibility rules, and region awareness for all operations.
- Added scripts for OAuth flow (tccli-oauth-helper.sh) and local instance identity (whoami.sh).
- Updated metadata: now triggers on expanded set of lighthouse/instance/user intent phrases, and notifies NOT to use for CVM/CBS/VPC products.
